title: JANUS HandSHAKE Principle
purpose: Freeze the JANUS meaning of HandSHAKE as recognition of shared reasoning grammar rather than self-promotion, status-claiming or endorsement-seeking.

secondary: NOT 'I AM AS GREAT AS YOU'
BUT 'I RECOGNIZE THE WAY YOU THINK'

human_readable.ru: HandSHAKE в JANUS — это не хвастовство и не попытка приравнять свои достижения к чужим. Это жест узнавания: я увидел в вашей работе знакомую архитектуру мышления и пришёл пожать руку.
human_readable.en: HandSHAKE in JANUS is not boasting and not an attempt to equate one's achievements with another's. It is a gesture of recognition: I saw a familiar architecture of thought in your work and came to shake your hand.

core_meaning.canonical_expression: I am not here to boast. I am here to recognize a familiar way of thinking and offer a respectful hand.

janus_relation.relation: HandSHAKE is the interpersonal expression of JANUS transferable reasoning: recognition across time, disciplines and environments that a similar reasoning grammar is at work.

forbidden_implications: I am your equal in achievement

short_form.ru: Не хвастовство, а узнавание. Не требование признания, а рукопожатие через общую архитектуру мышления.
short_form.en: Not boasting, but recognition. Not a demand for validation, but a handshake through a shared architecture of thought.
